remaining_open_gaps.reason: Compatibility currently relies on exact invariant strings. Semantic normalization, contradiction detection, MUST/MUST_NOT predicates, ambiguity handling, and synonym-resistant laundering detection are not yet implemented.
Failover guard now requires SKU, but the core qualification registry/qualification guard still needs provider+model+SKU/deployment-path metadata as first-class persisted qualification identity.

Review convergence still trusts reviewer-supplied false_positive_rate. Demotion must instead derive from retained independent adjudication/regression evidence and be reversible, versioned, and role/task/risk-specific.
Need explicit immutable max_review_rounds and terminal states CONVERGED_PASS, CONVERGED_FAIL, CEILING_REACHED_ESCALATE with no forced pass at the ceiling.
Current deterministic state-version/replay tests do not establish transactional deduplication or distributed linearizability under concurrent duplicate events.

The explicit py_compile step still does not list every governance module, although unittest discovery imports and executes them. Workflow should compile all governance Python files explicitly or compile the directory recursively.

scientific_interpretation: EXP-F has strong deterministic evidence across most authority, qualification, evidence, independence, TOCTOU, and failover false-green paths, but it is not complete. Full experiment PASS is withheld until semantic invariant laundering, qualification SKU/deployment-path identity, reviewer performance evidence, full convergence state semantics, and authoritative idempotency/linearizability gaps are closed and revalidated on an exact head.
